prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunlit Indian palace courtyard of pale sandstone with carved arches of standard height, low steps and a waist-high jali screen, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Lebanese woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, radiant glowing bridal makeup, dramatic long lashes, a soft rose lip, warm fair skin, soft strawberry-blonde hair styled in vintage victory rolls framing the face, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long platinum chain ending in one large faceted aquamarine drop, and on the other ear a large rose-gold hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on rose-gold chains of different lengths (a lead hammer head, a copper pyramid-shaped lump, a bronze chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a silver teardrop-shaped sinker, a silver miniature anvil), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and four to six layered platinum necklaces. Extremely long almond nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: an extraordinarily curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a sharply cinched waist rises out of hips that sweep outward in a single smooth violin-shaped curve, the hips and thick rounded thighs flaring many times wider than the waist and dominating her silhouette from the front and side, a firm high rounded rear, a full round bust balancing the curve above; the line from waist to hip to thigh is one long unbroken curve; not thin, not boyish, not a straight figure; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: Her body carries koi scales (rounded smooth scales with fine visible growth rings, each scale glossy and slightly domed), BLAZING ELECTRIC CRIMSON scale formations, VIVID PEARL WHITE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. It is fused to her own living skin and flexes slightly over every bulge, with no fabric, seam or garment anywhere. It covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left bare and the material fades out at the neck with no hard line.
LEFT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on her hip.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme white platform stiletto ankle boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Lebanese person with a handsome man's face on a full, curvaceous female body — a man in his early 30s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a handsome young man's idol face with a clean sharp jawline, straight thick brows and defined expressive eyes, a very faint trace of stubble, silver foil-lined eyes with a cool shimmer, smooth olive-tan skin, a soft amused smile, bold vivid violet-purple hair styled in a low chignon knot at the nape, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large brass hoop carrying one heavy rough hammered matte metal weight on brass chain (a silver round bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large platinum hoop carrying six heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on platinum chains of different lengths (a gold cube-shaped block, an iron hammer head, a bronze teardrop-shaped sinker, a silver barrel-shaped weight, a gold pyramid-shaped lump, a silver small flared temple bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten mixed-metal bracelets. Extremely long square nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: Her body carries layers of real feathers overlapping like plumage, every feather with its own shaft and fine barbs ruffling at the edges and casting small shadows on the feathers below, BLAZING glossy raven-black plumage with an oil-slick purple and green sheen, VIVID long sweeping quill feathers and loose down floating around her.
